_readme: For news coverage rather than papers. There is no established citation/peer-review signal for news, so that scoring is switched off. Recency becomes the dominant signal instead: a fast 'news' half-life is added and made the default field, the decay grace period shrinks from 2 years to 3 days, and the fresh-article bonus windows are tightened to reward same-day/same-week coverage over the old 1yr/2yr windows. Engagement (HN discussion of the article) stays on - it's a real signal for whether a piece of news actually mattered.
